name: Apify Actor
author: hearth-team
description: Run any Apify actor synchronously and get the dataset items back. Supply actor_id (e.g. apify/instagram-scraper) + the actor's input JSON. Bring your own APIFY_API_TOKEN; everything else is per-call.

vault_inputs.label: Apify API Token
vault_inputs.help: Console → Settings → Integrations → API → 'Personal API token'. Stored encrypted in the vault.

cost_estimate.note: Apify bills per actor — typically $0.01–$0.10/run, more for heavy scrapers
